packages.name: php@8.1
packages.title: php@8.1
packages.description: General-purpose scripting language

sourceDetails.caveats:
To enable PHP in Apache add the following to httpd.conf and restart Apache:
    LoadModule php_module $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/php@8.1/lib/httpd/modules/libphp.so

    <FilesMatch \.php$>
        SetHandler application/x-httpd-php
    </FilesMatch>

Finally, check DirectoryIndex includes index.php
    DirectoryIndex index.php index.html

The php.ini and php-fpm.ini file can be found in:
    $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/etc/php/8.1/
